req.title: Emit Swagger UI
req.statement: The system shall serve interactive Swagger UI documentation at GET /docs.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should serve interactive Swagger UI documentation at the endpoint GET /docs. This is a critical feature for API observability, allowing developers to explore and understand the API's capabilities. The test suite includes a positive test to verify the correct serving of the Swagger UI, a negative test to ensure proper error handling when accessing a non-existent endpoint, and a boundary test to check the response when accessing the endpoint with an incorrect HTTP method.

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_served
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/docs')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert 'text/html' in response.headers['Content-Type']

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_not_found
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/nonexistent')
assert response.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_method_not_allowed
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.post('/docs')
assert response.status_code == 405
